core_change_rule: CORE_CHANGE_REQUIRED; keep original attempt as failure under the frozen core. Do not modify core and relabel PASS.
allowed_method_changes: Case measurements and declarative contracts only.
comparisons: Same raw native observations, fields, histories, domain/type/eligibility semantics and failure identities for unchanged equality interpreter and independently implemented rich assertions. No weakened baseline; no delegation of baseline evaluation to the interpreter.

design.order: fixed project order; before/trigger, before/benign, fixed/trigger, fixed/benign; repeats 1..3

environment: No external service, cloud, production, global installs or unbounded resolver. Reuse verified local dependencies; new remote source assets must be public GitHub. Missing dependencies or beyond-bound changes cause HOLD.
native_gate: Exact frame02 parent receipt, case-authority/immutable source pair, fixture/runtime/contract/baseline integrity seal, then parent-provided independent nonauthor AI review BEFORE any native import/pilot/formal run. No extra human stage.
failure_rule: Preserve source/provenance, environment, native-reference, unsupported, invalid, core-change and budget failures. No substitutes after a case is chosen; infrastructure failures are not product defect detections.
inference: At most two local recorded-development-heldout lineages, not proof of broad generalization, zero prior model knowledge, human engineering benefit or production efficacy.
